evidence.result: GitHub Actions run 39042278396 failed during scene initialization without a rendering device. Run 39042625468 used a CPU llvmpipe device and completed PickCube-v1 seed 0: success=true, elapsed_steps=74, exit=0, no timeout or retry. Source archive and adapter hashes were unchanged.

observation: On Ubuntu 22.04, the pinned PickCube CPU/state recipe installed successfully but failed with failed to find a rendering device when no usable Vulkan ICD was present. The same source, adapter and package versions subsequently completed seed 0 after enabling Mesa lavapipe.
resolution: On the tested Ubuntu 22.04 host, install libvulkan1 and mesa-vulkan-drivers, then set VK_ICD_FILENAMES=/usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.x86_64.json before invoking the prepared command. Keep sim_backend=cpu and render_backend=none. This does not establish other platforms or graphics modes.
summary: CPU-only SAPIEN initialization needs a Vulkan ICD even with rendering output disabled

hub_validation.result: Exact catalog pins and bounded finding fields checked; no robot execution.
